expect.title: Things Not Mentioned in the Itinerary Must Be Paid by Customers
expect.body: Eg: Breakfast, Lunch, Additional Activities, Snacking, coffees.

expect.title: Super Peak Season
expect.body: New Zealand are super peak for tourism in summer season due to summer holidays and Lupin season. Expect high prices during summer.

expect.title: High Cost Country
expect.body: New Zealand have limited resources in terms of food, hotel, transports, manpower. Thus, the cost of living is expensive, so does things related to tourism in NZ.

expect.title: Long Journey Road Trip
expect.body: Long road trip from 1 place to another (2 - 4 hours), but keep your eyes open for mesmerising views along the way.

expect.title: Pack Light
expect.body: There will be daily check-in/out of hotel. Pack lightly and try to avoid bringing more than 1 luggage per pax for your own convenience.

expect.title: Motel, Inn & Hotel
expect.body: Expect to stay at motel and inn (3-4 stars) as most areas we are staying are small towns. But we ensure that you will not share apartment or bathroom with other guest.

expect.title: Visit to Supermarket and Convenient Store
expect.body: As breakfast and lunch are excluded, recommended to visit convenient store or supermarkets for Halal pastries & bread.

expect.title: Limited Breakfast Option
expect.body: Halal restaurant are hard to find during breakfast as most restaurant in NZ have late opening.

expect.title: Muslim Friendly Restaurant for Lunch
expect.body: Halal certified restaurant are limited at some area. Thus, we will recommend you to muslim-friendly restaurant serving halal meat for lunch.
